title: sync script: grep -v '^\.beads/' misses bare '.beads' path (symlink-era typechange entries)
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 pass 3.7. :81/:96/:162 filter only '^\.beads/' with trailing slash; a bare '.beads' unmerged entry would be handed to the session prompt and staged at :131, violating the 'store paths never handed to the session' invariant. Fix: grep -v '^\.beads\(/\|$\)'.
